summary: Artalk is a self-hosted comment system written in Go that allows you to embed a discussion section on websites. It acts as a lightweight alternative to hosted commenting widgets, giving you direct control over user-submitted text and metadata.
goodFor: It is well-suited for independent bloggers and developers running static site generators who want an open-source comment backend under their own control.
watchOut: You will need to manage your own database storage, moderation queues, and spam prevention since these operational tasks fall entirely on the administrator.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves running the container via Docker alongside a persistent volume for data storage, sitting behind a standard reverse proxy to handle TLS.
